A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IL-1 inhibitors have excellent retention rates in sJIA and that patients with prior biologic treatment or those experiencing adverse events are more likely to discontinue IL-1 inhibitor therapy.
IL-1 inhibitors should be considered first-line biologies for sJIA, especially in patients who have not been treated with any other biologic agent and who do not experience adverse events.
